title: Homogeneity in Reasoning Models: Do Chains of Thought Converge More Than Final Answers?

original_idea.body: Cluster CoT traces across reasoning models; compare CoT vs final-answer diversity.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: correlated reasoning paths undermine CoT-monitoring.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Intermediate: CoT clustering by solution-strategy taxonomy needs solid ML judgment.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused but trace clustering/taxonomy adds a dependency.

low_compute.reasoning: Reasoning models generate long traces; single mid GPU days.

novelty.reasoning: CoT-path homogeneity across models seems mostly unaddressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No direct work on cross-model CoT-path convergence known.
